concepts.proposed_markdown: `POST /v1/customer-alerts/list` returns threshold-notification configurations and current evaluation states for one required customer UUID. The default collection contains enabled configurations only; optional non-empty `alert_statuses` can include enabled, disabled, or archived configurations. Each response item requires nested `alert` configuration and nullable `customer_status`, which is otherwise `ok`, `in_alarm`, or `evaluating`; archived configurations return null status. Optional `triggered_by` can state why a threshold fired, and nested `alert.updated_at` is described as the customer-status update time. Complete traversal requires following nullable envelope `next_page`, while ordering, total count, snapshot consistency, duplicate-or-skip behavior, evaluation freshness, and history completeness are undocumented. This is a current monitoring read, not alert creation, reset, archival, webhook delivery, entitlement enforcement, or merchant action. [[source-metronome-api-reference-alerts-get-all-threshold-notifications]]
warnings: Preserve the enabled-only default separately from explicit disabled or archived inclusion.
Do not turn current configuration and evaluation state into notification history or delivery proof.
Do not treat cursor exhaustion as a stable or fresh monitoring snapshot.

concepts.proposed_markdown: For customer alert dashboards, admin panels, triggering checks, and coverage audits, bearer-authenticated `POST /v1/customer-alerts/list` returns configurations with current customer evaluation states. The default enabled-only filter can omit disabled and archived rules unless the caller explicitly includes those statuses, and complete retrieval requires following nullable envelope cursors. The page documents no ordering, page-size control, total count, cursor lifetime, stable snapshot, duplicate-or-skip behavior under change, as-of marker, evaluation freshness, or completeness guarantee. Nested `alert.updated_at` is a per-notification customer-status update timestamp, not a response-wide reporting watermark. This endpoint is distinct from in-app dashboards, generated reports, Data Export, webhook history, and merchant-built enforcement or notification delivery. [[source-metronome-api-reference-alerts-get-all-threshold-notifications]]
warnings: Dashboard and audit use cases do not establish a dashboard rendering, freshness, or completeness contract.
Include configuration-status scope when interpreting coverage.
Keep current API state distinct from reports, exports, webhook history, and downstream action.

concepts.proposed_markdown: `POST /v1/customer-alerts/list` is a paginated current-state read under the separate API-wide `Idempotency-Key` contract. Identical same-key parameters replay the original result, so replay is not proof of a fresh threshold evaluation, newly current configuration, or a new stable pagination snapshot. The endpoint page adds no behavior for absent, different, or expired keys; reuse or replacement of keys across `next_page` requests; concurrent alert configuration or evaluation changes; cursor replay; cached-error recovery; or read-after-change visibility. [[source-metronome-api-reference-alerts-get-all-threshold-notifications]] [[source-metronome-api-reference-idempotency]]
warnings: Separate request-result replay from current evaluation freshness.
Do not infer pagination snapshot stability from use of the same idempotency key.
Preserve endpoint-specific retry, cursor, concurrency, and recovery unknowns.
